Decaf + LR Sections Routine
Why Are We Doing This?

Now we're ready to put the whole process together into full LR question answering 🎉

Mini-Cycles and Acronyms alternate in this Routine to see which Workout produces higher accuracy and how big of a timing gap we see between them.

This Routine gives us a headstart on the Accuracy Prep Stage (and a sneak preview on which Accuracy Fixes might be relevant to us) while giving us time to beat Decaf once and for all!

How To Pull This Off

It is extremely important that you complete the workouts in this Routine in the order written here.

The order is important to ensure that you can progress in a reasonable time span. (Yes, all Routines are supposed to be done in the order I write them! But can you tell I'm very often disobeyed? This Routine is very often reordered and progress suffers.)

The Mini-Cycles and Acronyms are not more important to complete than the Translation + CLIR warmup and the Decaf RC Translation.

Do not prioritize the Mini-Cycles and Acronyms more than the rest of the Routine just because you're excited to answer questions.

Completing at least one section of Decaf every day is the bare minimum to allow that skill to grow.

Completing a Decaf Marathon at least once per week will make the daily Decaf practice far more smooth and accessible.

Whenever I say to "alternate" workouts in a Routine, switch which Workout you do each day. For example, if the Routine says, "Alternate: X // Y (1:1)," that means that I should do X on day 1 and then switch to doing Y the next time I do the Routine. The (1:1) numbers signal how many times you should do each Workout before switching to other Workout.

How To Move On

You can move on to the MemAC Routine or Cappuccino + LR Translation Routine once your Decaf RC Translation Drill speed reaches the goal, while keeping recaps high-quality throughout.

Decaf RC Translation Speed Goals

12 minutes per passage out loud (including out loud recaps)
I hit 12 minutes on Decaf RC Translation with out loud recaps or 8 minutes on Decaf RC Translation with silent recaps
Extra Help

These resources will help you meet the Translation Routine goals more quickly and easily.
